map.✅ 各大航空公司行李规定汇总: ✅ Summary of Luggage Rules from Major Airlines
map.将衣物卷成圆筒状，比折叠更省空间且减少褶皱: Roll garments into cylinders, which saves more space than folding and reduces creases
map.使用压缩收纳袋分类放置衣物，便于查找和节省空间: Use compression bags to group clothing, making it easier to find things and saving space
map.鞋子、洗漱包等重物放在行李底部，保持重心稳定: Put shoes and toiletry bags and other heavy items at the bottom to keep the center of gravity stable
map.袜子、内衣等小件物品塞进鞋子或边角空隙: Stuff socks, underwear and other small items into shoes or empty corners
map.贵重物品、证件、充电宝必须随身，不要托运: Valuables, documents and power banks must be carried on, not checked
map.随身液体单瓶不超过100ml，总量不超过1L，装透明袋: Carry-on liquids are limited to 100ml per container and 1L in total, and must go in a transparent bag
map.需包含轮子、拉杆、把手在内的最大外围尺寸: Use the maximum outer dimensions including wheels, telescoping handle and grab handles
map.廉航对重量检查较严格，超重费用很高: Low-cost airlines check weight strictly and overweight fees are high
map.航空公司金卡/白金卡会员通常有额外行李额度: Gold and Platinum members of an airline usually get extra baggage allowance
map.商务舱/头等舱行李额度通常是经济舱的2倍: Business and first class baggage allowance is usually twice that of economy
map.星空联盟、寰宇一家等联盟会员可能享受额外额度: Members of alliances such as Star Alliance or Oneworld may enjoy extra allowance
map.⚠️ 以上数据仅供参考，各航空公司可能随时调整规定。出行前请务必查询航空公司官网: ⚠️ The data above is for reference only, and airlines may change the rules at any time. Always check the airline's official website for the latest baggage policy before travelling.
map.📚 深度解析：行李尺寸合规检查: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Luggage Size Compliance Check
map.尺寸 34×50×20cm，三边和 104cm；国航随身限 115cm→尺寸符合: Dimensions 34×50×20cm give a three-side sum of 104cm; Air China's carry-on limit is 115cm, so the size passes and with weight ≤5kg it passes overall. A three-side sum of 118 would be flagged as "close to the limit".
map.亚航/瑞安等随身常限 90–100cm 且 7kg，同箱可能 fail；切到 l: Airlines such as AirAsia and Ryanair often limit carry-on to 90 to 100cm and 7kg, so the same case may fail; switch to the lcc filter to see the difference.
map.三边和怎么算？: How is the three-side sum computed?
map.长＋宽＋高；部分航司还单列单边上限，工具同时比对尺寸与重量。: Length + width + height. Some airlines also cap each side separately, so the tool compares both dimensions and weight.
